common:generalComment.#text: Thermal energy, used for district or industrial heating, is primarily supplied by natural gas fuel. common:synonyms.#text: mineral oil; white mineral oil; liquid paraffin; paraffinum liquidum

common:generalComment.#text: Mineral oil is a colorless, transparent, oily liquid derived from crude petroleum oil. It is utilized for various purposes including treating dry skin, constipation, eczema, cradle cap, and facilitating bowel movements. Mineral oil is also a by-product from the refining of crude oil and the manufacturing of gasoline and petroleum products. It is odorless and used in cosmetics, science labs, industrial settings, and more. Despite its industrial origins, it has applications in the kitchen and is a refined petroleum oil used as a laxative.
矿物油是一种由原油衍生而来的无色透明油状液体。它用于各种目的，包括治疗皮肤干燥、便秘、湿疹、乳痂和促进排便。矿物油也是原油精炼以及汽油和石油产品制造的副产品。它无味，用于化妆品、科学实验室、工业环境等。尽管它起源于工业，但它在厨房中也有应用，是一种用作泻药的精炼石油。

common:generalComment.#text: An offcut or off-cut is material left over after a workpiece is cut or processed, such as in masonry, metalworking, woodworking, industrial or domestic food processing, and textile manufacturing. An offcut is waste material which can sometimes be reused, recycled, or sold as scrap.

common:generalComment.#text: Sawdust is a byproduct of the lumber industry, created when wood is cut or milled into lumber. It comprises tiny wood particles ranging from fine dust to small chips. Commonly used as a fuel source, sawdust can also serve as a soil amendment. It is particularly beneficial for low-pH crops like blueberries, strawberries, and raspberries, acting as an inexpensive mulch option. Sawdust's powdery texture and light brown or gray color result from the sawing, sanding, or grinding of wood during processing.
木屑是木材工业的副产品，是在木材被切割或研磨成木材时产生的。它由细小的木屑颗粒组成，从细小的灰尘到细小的碎屑。木屑通常用作燃料来源，也可以用作土壤改良剂。它对蓝莓、草莓和树莓等低pH作物特别有益，是一种廉价的覆盖物。木屑的粉状质地和浅棕色或灰色是在加工过程中锯切、打磨或研磨木材产生的。

solvent-based planographic printing ink; solvent-based offset ink; solvent-based lithographic ink

common:generalComment.#text: Solvent ink refers to printing ink made of various oil-based solvents (volatile organic compounds). It is used for a wide range of printing solutions due to its capability to print on unlimited surfaces. Solvent-based inks are popular in the printing market due to their amazing print quality. The ink is dissolved in another substance, which can be glycol ether esters or glycol esters and their derivatives. Water is not used to dissolve the ink. The printing industry categorizes this type of ink based on the amount of heat that is necessary to dry the solvent once it is applied on the medium.
溶剂油墨是指由各种油基溶剂（挥发性有机化合物）制成的印刷油墨。由于其能在无限的表面上打印，因此被广泛用于各种印刷解决方案。由于其出色的打印质量，溶剂型油墨在印刷市场上非常受欢迎。油墨是溶解在另一种物质中，这种物质可以是乙二醇醚酯或乙二醇酯及其衍生物。水不用于溶解油墨。印刷行业根据在介质上应用溶剂后，需要多少热量来干燥溶剂，对这种类型的油墨进行分类。

common:synonyms.#text: starch; amylum
淀粉

common:generalComment.#text: Starch is a white, granular, organic chemical produced by all green plants. It is a polysaccharide composed of glucose monomers linked in α 1,4 linkages. Starch is utilized in the food, paper, and textile industries and is a staple carbohydrate in the human diet. It serves as an energy store in plants and is biodegradable. Starch is the most commonly consumed type of carbohydrate and an important energy source, found in cereal grains and root vegetables.
淀粉是一种由所有绿色植物产生的白色颗粒状有机化学物质。它是一种多糖，由以 α 1,4 连接方式连接的葡萄糖单体组成。淀粉可用于食品、造纸和纺织工业，也是人类饮食中的主要碳水化合物。它是植物的能量储存剂，可生物降解。淀粉是最常见的碳水化合物，也是重要的能量来源，存在于谷物和根茎类蔬菜中。

common:generalComment.#text: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material containing clay minerals such as hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates. Clays develop plasticity when wet but can be hardened through firing. Most pure clay minerals are white or light-coloured, but natural clays show a variety of colours. Clay materials are plastic when wet and coherent when dry. Clay minerals are a group of hydrous aluminosilicates that are formed from the weathering and alteration of silicate minerals.
黏土是一种含有如水合铝酸盐等黏土矿物的细粒自然土壤材料。黏土在湿润时会变得塑性，但可以通过烧制来硬化。大多数纯黏土矿物是白色或浅色的，但自然黏土显示出各种颜色。黏土材料在湿润时是塑性的，干燥时是连贯的。黏土矿物是一组由硅酸盐矿物的风化和改变形成的含水铝硅酸盐。

common:synonyms.#text: 涂布印刷书写纸；涂布包装纸
coated printing and writing paper; coated packaging paper

common:generalComment.#text: Coating is a process that occurs during paper manufacturing to give paper a professional appearance and protect it from scuffing and rubbing. It comes in gloss, matte, or varnish forms. Varnish is a clear, transparent coating applied to a printed piece during or after printing to protect the printed material against fingerprints, smudges, and scuffs, and enhance the packaging's colors and overall appearance. Aqueous coating (AQ) is a transparent, water-based varnish applied during the printing process. It dries quickly, resists fingerprints, is environmentally friendly, and supports unique packaging designs.
涂层是纸张制造过程中的一个环节，用于赋予纸张专业外观并保护其免受擦伤和摩擦。涂层有光泽、哑光或清漆等形式。清漆是一种透明的涂层，用于在印刷过程中或印刷后应用于印刷品，以保护印刷材料免受指纹、污渍和擦伤的影响，并增强包装的颜色和整体外观。水性涂层（AQ）是在印刷过程中应用的透明、水基清漆。它干燥速度快，抵抗指纹，环保，并支持独特的包装设计。
